Description of Service

GanaTube.in is a music discovery and streaming platform that aggregates music content and public metadata from third-party media sources and providers. Our Services allow you to:

  • Search and discover music content
  • Stream music and audio content
  • Create and manage playlists
  • Save favorite songs
  • Share music with friends
  • Access music recommendations
  • Use playlist and queue tools for personal listening

GanaTube.in aggregates content and metadata from public third-party services. Specifically, we utilize:

  • Public third-party music providers and metadata databases for music search, cataloging, and discovery functionality
  • Third-party web streaming providers for audio and media content playback

We do not host, store, upload, or own the media content accessible through our Services. All content is dynamically indexed from third-party sources, and we act solely as a search and discovery platform.

Important Notice: We are not affiliated with, endorsed by, or officially partnered with any commercial music platform or recording label. We index publicly available web content for discovery and educational purposes only.

Third-Party Services and Content Providers

Our Services rely on third-party infrastructure and providers to deliver music information, metadata, search results, and media playback. These include:

  • Music Information Services: We use third-party data providers for search indexing, song metadata, album art, and artist biographies. We do not own this data and act strictly as an indexer.
  • Public Media Sources: Media streaming is delivered through third-party public web sources. Your interaction with third-party content through our Services remains subject to the respective terms and conditions of those third-party providers.
  • Authentication Services: We offer secure user authentication (such as Google Sign-In) for personal library management.
  • Cloud Infrastructure: We utilize standard cloud hosting and storage for application delivery and user preference synchronization.

We aggregate and present content from these third-party sources, but we do not claim ownership of the content. All music, audio, video, artwork, and related content remain the property of their respective copyright holders.

Your use of third-party content through our Services is subject to the terms and policies of those respective third-party providers. We are not responsible for the availability, accuracy, or legality of content hosted on external networks.
